**P2 — Revalidate cases after collecting additional evidence**

This refresh runs after `execute_case()` performs its final lifecycle audit. If it discovers checkpoint/poll activity after an earlier request's wrapper return, it merely caches that evidence; the case retains PASS. Subsequent iterations and `collect()` also never revalidate completed cases. Retain each case's invocation range and re-audit affected cases after the final refresh before accepting their results. Add a driver test that delivers the violating backend-call records during this refresh.
